title: Creator Signal
description: A creator's trading intent. Deliberately carries no size, no notional and no account. Presence of any sizing or targeting field is a 422, never a silent ignore.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per agent. Replay returns the original signal_id. Same key with a different body is a 409.

instrument_type.description: CRYPTO added in phase 1.5. No futures instrument type exists on the order API.

symbol.description: Ticker for equities. Exact OSI symbol for options, e.g. AAPL260320C00280000. Public never resolves selection criteria into a contract in phase one.

limit_price.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT. Passed through unchanged; never per-subscriber adjusted.

open_close.description: Options only. Required when instrument_type is OPTION.

position_ref.description: Creator-assigned. Links EXIT and CANCEL to the originating ENTRY. Unknown ref on EXIT is a 422.

proposal_ttl_seconds.description: Clamped to the agent manifest's max_proposal_ttl_seconds.

note.description: Creator rationale. Rendered verbatim with creator attribution. Never summarized or rewritten by Public.

$comment: REJECTED FIELDS — must return 422 with the offending field named, not be dropped: quantity, amount, notional, account_id, percent_of_account, risk_percent, leverage, subscriber_id, target_subscribers. additionalProperties:false enforces this; the error message must name the field so the creator understands sizing is not theirs to set.
